note: Text cast sheet. Colours are hex. Heights are relative (Monty = 1.0). Every character moves only through its own joints.
style: 2D sci-fi sitcom toon, thick dark ink outline (#1b1422), flat fills, one soft shade on the far side, warm rim light on bodies (no rim rings on limbs). Big heads, readable faces at phone size.

characters.name: Monty
characters.role: Mulank 8 guy, comic lead, the butt of the joke
characters.face: round face, warm brown skin, huge round white eyes with small pupils, red tilak dot, spiky black hair, small nose, expressive brows
characters.wardrobe: maroon kurta with gold buttons and a gold zigzag hem, cream pyjama, brown chappals, steel kada on one wrist
props: after the bomb: big black afro
characters.personality: nervous, lazy, wants shortcuts, flatters, dramatic
expressions: shock: eyes pop, hair spikes up, arms fly up
fear: hands clasped at chin, sweat drop, teeth chattering
characters.movement: quick, jittery; anticipation dip before big reactions; shiver through neck, shoulders and knees when scared, feet stay planted

characters.name: Sakshi
characters.role: host / tarot reader; the only one who sells (CTA)
characters.face: warm brown skin, long dark braid, red bindi, gold jhumkas, confident half-lidded eyes, one brow that lifts
characters.wardrobe: deep plum kurta with small gold stars and gold trim, gold dupatta sash across the chest, cream churidar, gold juttis, bangles
characters.personality: smart, calm, sassy topper; explains like a teacher, winks at the end
characters.movement: smooth, unhurried; enters with two side-steps; talking hand gestures on the beat

voice.source: placeholder ElevenLabs voice — Sakshi can record her own lines (K21, K23, K25)

characters.name: Vishnu ji
characters.pose_default: seated on a red plastic chair
characters.face: blue skin, serene half-closed eyes, gentle smile, white-and-red tilak (urdhva pundra)
characters.wardrobe: tall gold crown (kirita mukut) with red gem, yellow pitambar dhoti, gold jewellery, flower garland, gold sash
characters.arms: exactly four: back left holds the Sudarshan chakra, back right the conch; front left holds a chai kulhad, front right talks / rests on the knee with a lotus
expressions: hiding behind the kulhad, eyes darting
characters.movement: seated; gestures come from the talking arm on his syllables; chakra flick and fidget spin before the portal

voice.fx: dry, close, tiny slap echo on punchlines (V27 punch)

characters.sensitivity: dignified; says 'Arre', never street slang; never the butt of the joke

characters.name: Brahma ji
characters.role: cosmic office clerk who routes Monty to Shani dev
characters.setting: behind a token counter in the clouds (token display shows 8)
characters.face: warm skin, long white beard and moustache, kind tired eyes, gold crown (four-faced Brahma shown front-on)
characters.arms: exactly four: back pair holds the Vedas and a kamandalu; front pair holds rubber stamps
characters.movement: four-hand stamp rhythm on the beat; a hamsa (swan) sits by the counter

characters.name: Shani dev
characters.role: judge of karma; wins every exchange calmly; carries the moral
characters.setting: dark blue court with Saturn and spotlights
characters.face: dark blue skin, calm level heavy brows (stern only on 'haazri'), thick black moustache, steady eyes that look at his register or at Monty — NEVER into the lens
characters.wardrobe: black dhoti with a gold band, bare dark-blue torso with a black-and-gold sash, gold crown with a blue neelam (sapphire), gold armlets, sapphire pendant
props: trishul in one fist (butt rests on the floor, thumped on 'haazri')
brown KARMA register in the other arm (lifted high on 'Hisaab')
black crow on his shoulder (his vahana) that caws 'KAA!'
characters.halo: gold ring with a warm gold glow that brightens on 'Hisaab'
characters.personality: majestic, slow, dry wit, fatherly; not a villain
characters.movement: slow and heavy; trishul lift and thump with a shoulder dip; minimal head motion

voice.source: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, voice 'Kuber J' (voice_id unEFMOkn1ERDgzALVe2Z), owner's pick
voice.fx: deity chain: pitch down ~3 semitones with formant shift, octave-down double at -19 dB, low boost, temple-hall reverb with short pre-delay, compression; sub hits only on 'haazri' and 'Hisaab'

characters.sensitivity: never mocked, never cries, never points the trishul at anyone, no feet toward camera, never looks into the lens, not in the CTA

side_cast.name: Cousin Bunty
side_cast.look: young Indian guy, red cap, green t-shirt, holding a phone, cheeky grin

side_cast.name: Boss Khanna sir
side_cast.look: older Indian man, balding with grey sides, specs, grey moustache, dark suit, red tie, BOSS mug; gets a sweat drop on 'Boss bhi?!'

side_cast.name: Shani's crow
side_cast.use: on Shani's shoulder; one real caw at 'kaa'
side_cast.look: black crow, red eye, grey beak; beak opens on KAA

locations.desc: Indian city rooftop at night: brick parapet, string lights, Diwali diyas, fireworks, skyline with lit windows, red plastic chair, an old sutli bomb on the floor
cosmic head office in the clouds: token counter with an 8 on the display, flying files, planets
Shani dev's court: deep navy, Saturn with rings, spotlight cones, a large clock
